# The OLT side of one ISP1 provisioning session, from cold boot to the last
# service: one baseline OMCI frame per line, for src/omci/drv-test.sh.
# Rebuilt from the omcid log of that session by
# src/omci/tools/session-from-log.py: the log keeps the first 16 bytes of
# each message contents (20 for a GemPortCtp create), so the rest are zero
# unless restored below, and a get carries the mask of its answer. CRC zero.
# Restored (the "# restored" lines below, offsets in the contents):
#   84/4@24     VlanTagFilterData creates: FwdOp 0x10, one entry, as a MIB
#               readback of the same stick shows for all five;
#   t60710@16   the ExtVlan untagged rule: treatment inner VID 1 TPID 4, from
#               the same readback;
#   t60605/t60678/t60702@16  the eighth p-bit pointer of the three mapper
#               sets that name one IW TP for p-bits 0-6: the same one;
#   130/4@16    the eighth p-bit pointer of the mapper creates: null, like
#               the seven logged.
# Scrubbed: omcid withholds the contents of the credential and address classes
# (here 5 AuthSecMethod, 3 LargeString, 3 TR069ManageServer sets), so those
# carry zeros; the one OltG set (OLT vendor and equipment ids) is zeroed too.
# Regenerated only from a session log; a frame is not edited by hand.
# restored: 130/4@16=ffff (5 messages)
# restored: 84/4@24=1001 (5 messages)
# restored: t60605@16=0001 (1 message)
# restored: t60678@16=0004 (1 message)
# restored: t60702@16=0005 (1 message)
# restored: t60710@16=000c (1 message)
